title: Paper v2 live approval lifecycle is missing for future MiniQMT live promotion
description:
Expected: Before any future MiniQMT live execution, AIstock must require a live approval lifecycle: StrategyPackage alpha core completeness, platform runtime release/profile version, validated execution/tail policy evidence, minimum paper/MiniQMT SIM validation run evidence, broker compatibility verification, human approval, approver, approval timestamp, risk note, and rollback plan. Paper-enabled or paper-passed status must not automatically grant live eligibility.
Actual: StrategyPackage PackageStatus only models DRAFT, ASSET_VALIDATED, BACKTEST_APPROVED, SELECTION_ENABLED, PAPER_ENABLED, PAPER_RUNNING, PAPER_PASSED, PAPER_FAILED, RETIRED. Paper v2 and qmt_strategy_ledger flows have no explicit LIVE_CANDIDATE/LIVE_APPROVAL_PENDING/LIVE_APPROVED lifecycle or approval evidence. Existing docs mention live_approval_reserved, but code lacks an enforceable approval model and gate.
required_verification: Live approval records reference immutable package alpha core hash plus runtime release/profile/policy hashes.
Live route or live-like MiniQMT promotion is blocked without simulation validation evidence and human approval.
Paper status alone cannot grant live eligibility.
closure_requirements: Explicit live approval lifecycle exists before MiniQMT live is enabled.
Approval, rejection, retirement, and rollback are auditable.
